Video sponsored by MSI. The MSI MPG 341CQR QD-OLED X36 is an exceptional ultrawide 360Hz OLED display. Learn more here: https://msi.gm/SFEDF663

Ultrawide displays give PC gaming something consoles don't deliver - a wider, more expansive view of the game world, combined with other cutting-edge technologies: 360Hz, the latest QD-OLED tech, adaptive sync and more. In this video, John Linneman - an ultrawide gamer himself - offers up his view on what makes the technology so impressive, while showcasing some of this favourite experiences.
